episodes.title: The Ugly Truth
episodes.summary: Enigmatic student Nanno transfers to a school that has recently earned the title of "Purest School of the Year," but she soon exposes the ugly truth.

episodes.title: Apologies
episodes.summary: The boys all want to take advantage of Nanno and the girls are jealous and cruel. They try to destroy her, but Nanno always has the upper hand.

episodes.title: Trophy
episodes.summary: Surrounded by so-called geniuses, struggling student Mew feels stupid and invisible in her school -- until Nanno shows her a shortcut to success.

episodes.title: Hi-So
episodes.summary: Even among the filthy-rich kids at his school, Dino stands out -- but he's got a secret. Nanno can help him keep it, but it will cost him.

episodes.title: Social Love
episodes.summary: Hann has a girlfriend, but he becomes a social media sensation at school when he gets mistakenly linked to Nanno, and he really enjoys the attention.

episodes.title: Wonderwall Part 1
episodes.summary: The head of the school football team is filled with envy when Nanno becomes her co-manager, and her resentment begins to manifest itself in eerie ways.

episodes.title: Wonderwall Part 2
episodes.summary: Other students learn about the bathroom wall and start using it to get their own revenge. Bam regrets what she's started, but it may be too late.

episodes.title: Lost & Found
episodes.summary: TK can't stop stealing, and his new friend Nanno only encourages him to continue. But underneath it all, he's just a lonely kid who misses his father.

episodes.title: Trap
episodes.summary: While hiding from an escaped murderer terrorizing their school, a group of students and their teacher soon begin to turn on one another.

episodes.title: Thank You, Teacher
episodes.summary: Ms. Aum is told by the school director to change her strict teaching style. But the stress of her past pushes her beyond the breaking point.

episodes.title: The Rank
episodes.summary: In a school that ranks its students in order of beauty, Ying is mortified when Nanno outranks her, and goes to extreme lengths to reclaim her spot.

episodes.title: BFF Part 1
episodes.summary: After opening a time capsule at a high school reunion, former pupils recall an odd girl they nicknamed "Psycho Nanno," who was briefly in their class.

episodes.title: BFF Part 2
episodes.summary: The truth about what really happened back in high school is revealed. Nobody is innocent, and Nanno makes sure there are no happy endings.

episodes.title: Pregnant
episodes.summary: Nanai is a popular boy in school with a bad habit of getting girls pregnant, so Nanno decides to give him a taste of his own medicine.

episodes.title: True Love
episodes.summary: When an elite girls' school starts accepting boys, Nanno pushes against strict rules that discourage the boys and girls from interacting.

episodes.title: Minnie and the Four Bodies
episodes.summary: Because of her rich and connected father, Minnie never has to face any consequences — until her recklessness gets her classmates killed.

episodes.title: Yuri
episodes.summary: Nanno tries to help a poor student named Yuri get even with the rich classmates who treat her like a servant, but Nanno may have met her match.

episodes.title: SOTUS
episodes.summary: A senior student named Kaye takes things too far while hazing a group of junior students. This time, it's Nanno's turn to try and break his spirit.

episodes.title: Liberation
episodes.summary: At Pantanawittaya, students are expected to strictly follow rules without question, but Nanno relishes breaking as many as she can.

episodes.title: JennyX
episodes.summary: Popular influencer JennyX's parents pressure her to maintain her image to keep the profits rolling in, but things change when she meets Nanno.

episodes.title: The Judgement
episodes.summary: Nanno and Yuri's rivalry comes to a head over the fate of a mother and daughter who may be responsible for a slew of disappearances and deaths.
